turns.customer: Need a standard suite for my dog Nala Dec 23 to Dec 27, 2026. What are the deposit and cancellation rules for that?
blocks:
For Nala’s **standard-suite stay, December 23–27, 2026**, the Cedar Park resort’s published policy says holiday dog boarding requires a **$100 deposit per suite** and **at least five days’ cancellation notice before the first boarding day** to avoid forfeiting it. If you cancel with less notice—or don’t show—the deposit is forfeited. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/reservation-requirements-cancellation-policy?utm_source=openai))

The policy also notes that major holidays may require reservations **two weeks to two months in advance**, depending on the holiday. I can’t confirm whether these dates are classified as holiday dates under the resort’s policy, or check availability; please verify those details with the resort before relying on the holiday terms. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/reservation-requirements-cancellation-policy?utm_source=openai))

turns.customer: Your rates page says it's just 24 hours notice and no deposit though?
blocks:

Its separate **reservation/cancellation policy page** says holiday boarding requires a **$100 standard-suite deposit** and five days’ notice, with the deposit forfeited for a late cancellation or no-show.
